incoming.name: Bog
incoming.excerpt: Excellent examples of such human specimens are Haraldskær Woman and Tollund Man in Denmark.

outgoing.name: Denmark
outgoing.excerpt: The Jómsvíkinga saga tells that Queen Gunhild was murdered and then drowned in a bog, her death having been ordered by the Danish Harald Bluetooth.

outgoing.name: Germany
outgoing.excerpt: Geographically the principal locations where bog bodies have been discovered are Denmark, northern Germany, Holland, the United Kingdom and Ireland.
